chapters.text: Kirock Homes. Take a photo and invite three suspects into a group chat.
One real photograph. The objects wake up.
Upload another real desk photograph and place three faces.
The photograph stays intact as the objects join your group chat.
Ask a question. The addressed witness answers; another object can interject.
Three fixed statements. One false statement. One final accusation.
Optional Crew edition. These are exact responses from a previously recorded Kiro session.
The public web game uses authored replies. Find the Kiro records and optional Crew app in the repository.
